description_ru: Кандидат проходит собеседование на должность менеджера проекта и отвечает на непростые вопросы.
text:
Ms Grant: Please have a seat, Mr Weber. Thank you for coming in today.

Adam: Thank you for inviting me. I've been looking forward to this.

Ms Grant: Let's start with your experience. Your CV says that you have managed international projects for six years.

Adam: That's right. In my last job I was responsible for a team of twelve people in three countries. We delivered a new booking system two months ahead of schedule.

Ms Grant: Impressive. Was it difficult to work across different time zones?

Adam: At first, yes. People were often waiting for answers overnight. So I suggested that we should have a short video meeting every Tuesday morning, and that solved most of the problems.

Ms Grant: Interesting. Can you describe a situation in which a project went wrong?

Adam: Certainly. Two years ago, a major client told us that he wanted to change the whole design a week before the deadline. I was tempted to say no, but instead I asked him to explain his reasons.

Ms Grant: And what did you learn?

Adam: That he was under pressure from his own board. Once I understood that, we found a compromise. We kept the original design and added two features that mattered most to him. He was delighted, and he has remained a loyal customer ever since.

Ms Grant: That sounds like a mature approach. Many candidates would have panicked. How do you usually deal with stress?

Adam: I try to keep a cool head. I also believe that a good manager should be honest about problems early, rather than sweeping them under the carpet.

Ms Grant: I agree. One more question. Where do you see yourself in five years?

Adam: Ideally, leading a larger department here. I've read that your company plans to open offices in Asia, and I'd love to be part of that growth.

Ms Grant: Well, we were told by several colleagues that you were an excellent speaker, and now I can see why. We will contact you by Friday.

Adam: Thank you very much, Ms Grant. It was a pleasure to meet you.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Округлите губы вперёд, как для «у», и быстро раскройте их; зубы не касаются губы, иначе получится «в».
Верхние зубы касаются нижней губы, голос включён; не оглушайте звук в конце слова.
Кончик языка слегка просуньте между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на «с» или «з».
Кончик языка не касается нёба и не вибрирует; оттяните язык назад и слегка округлите губы.

questions.question: How many years has Adam managed international projects?
How often did Adam's team have a video meeting?
What did the client want to change?
When will the company contact Adam?
